**PR title guidance (optional)**
Prefer a conventional-style title like `feat: add color picker` or `fix: prevent duplicate palette entries`. This makes changelogs and releases easier.

## Changelog entry
Please add one-line changelog entry for `CHANGELOG.md` under the appropriate category.

- Category (choose one): Added / Changed / Fixed / Deprecated / Removed / Security
- One-line entry (user-facing): 

Example:
- Added: Bulk-import palettes from JSON.

If this is a trivial internal change (formatting, refactor, dependency bump) mark "No changelog needed".
